'''2004 DPC Atlanta Kevin Elia LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Elia]] at [[2004 DPC Atlanta]], finishing 3rd; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Kevin "yavinite" Elia (2004-10-19).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33896 nonProfit]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071220125209/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=33896 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Approximate list: poster says "plus or minus 3 cards" from what he played at DPC Atlanta (3rd) and Mystic Visions (2nd).<ref name="src" />
